name: sweatstack-bridge
description: An OpenID Provider that brokers your athletes' Garmin sign-in to SweatStack Sign-In, and a client of SweatStack's public API that relays their data.

SWEATSTACK_URL.description: Where SweatStack runs. Leave as is unless you're pointed at staging.

SWEATSTACK_APP_ID.description: Your app's client id, from the OAuth tab of your app in SweatStack. You can leave this empty for now.

GARMIN_CLIENT_ID.description: Your client id from Garmin's developer program. You can leave this empty for now.

BACKFILL_DAYS.description: Days of history to request when an athlete connects. A whole number; 90 is a sensible default.

SWEATSTACK_CLIENT_SECRET.description: A client secret of your app, from its OAuth tab in SweatStack. Make a separate one for the bridge, so the two rotate independently.

GARMIN_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Your client secret from Garmin's developer program. Sent to Garmin's token endpoint and nowhere else.
